chunks: As for what Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad narrated from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, from his brother al-Ḥusayn, from ʿAlī ibn Yaqṭīn, who said:

I asked Abā al-Ḥasan عليه السلام about a man who forgets to make the iqāmah for the salat (prayer) after he has already begun the salat (prayer). He said: If he has finished his salat (prayer), then his salat (prayer) is complete; and if he has not finished his salat (prayer), then let him repeat. So this report is to be understood as referring to a type of recommendation.

key_terms.أَبَا الْحَسَنِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, the one being asked for the ruling
key_terms.يُقِيمَ: to say the iqāmah before salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone forgets the iqāmah and remembers after starting the salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling for one who forgets the iqāmah and only remembers after beginning the salat (prayer). If the salat (prayer) has been completed, it remains valid; if it has not yet been completed, repeating is mentioned, though the report is understood as carrying the sense of recommendation rather than obligation.
